answer_2.quote: An example was labelled as correct if the log likelihood score of the correct continuation string was higher than the log likelihood score of the incorrect continuation.

answer_4.quote: We asked English-speaking and Romanian-speaking adults to answer dataset questions of the form "if {premise1} and {premise2}, does that imply that {conclusion}?" with "yes" or "no". The respondents were told that the aim was to collect a set of commonsense responses from humans and compare them to LLMs responses, which they consented to.
